summary: Isolate ambiguous GitHub description markers per issue during inbound list_tickets

delivery.outcome: GitHubBackend._list_tickets quarantines individual issues raising sync_github_description_markers_ambiguous with bounded body-free diagnostics so inbound sync processes valid issues cleanly, while direct reads, selected reads, search recovery, and mutations remain fail-closed.
nonGoals: Do not unwrap or guess ambiguous nested planfile:description sections
Do not mutate historical GitHub issue bodies automatically
Do not weaken single-issue get_ticket, update_ticket, create_ticket, list_selected_tickets, or search_tickets guards
Do not edit foreign-owned sync or store files

architecture.decision: Quarantine only ValueError('sync_github_description_markers_ambiguous') per issue in GitHubBackend._list_tickets, recording bounded body-free diagnostics and skipping limit starvation, while keeping _description_bounds and all targeted read/write/search methods unchanged and fail-closed.
architecture.rollback: Revert the bounded single-file commit in planfile/sync/github.py through protected delivery.
